scope: Owned per-question DNS server selection and rebuilt lookup/search regressions.

dns-server-source.scope: Concurrent borrowed server selectors: complete orders, atomic steps, teardown.

dns-search-rotation.scope: Owned per-question server rotation through search, aliases and retries.

dns-search-servers.scope: Search suffixes composed with multi-server address/alias lookup and recovery.

dns-address-search.scope:
Single-server DNS search over real loopback TCP exchanges.

Checks DNS RCODE classification, selected-empty replies, search precedence,
alias follow-ups, refusal, EOF/reset/partial framing, shared deadline and
terminal source/validation/abort errors.
This is not a server retry, OS configuration or full resolver test.

c.provenance: Instrumented baseline; no cache-lifetime or GC changes

dns-lookup-ids.scope:
Fresh injected/OS DNS IDs per exchange, with typed failure and abort cleanup.

Live random IDs may repeat. Checks assert request/reply matching and source
call counts, never sample uniqueness or cryptographic quality.

dns-lookup-shared.scope:
Two address lookups share one caller-owned deadline and entropy source.

Loopback TCP replies exercise success, expiry between/during calls, pre-abort,
validation and source failure on native one/four threads and Bun.

limitations: Random initial selection, configuration reload and OS resolver ownership remain unimplemented.
Standalone selector channel audit does not cover all network resources.
No compiler patch installed. Native single-server regression uses phase-instrumented baseline output, byte-identical to the isolated cache experiment.
New rotating-search tests preceded comment-only edits in lookup/search modules. Original test source hashes are retained; current source hashes are recorded separately.
